title: The Cave Entrance
shot: wide, then medium as he changes direction
camera: panning follow, then a whip pan onto the cave mouth
action: KAIRO bursts between rocks and grass, spots a dark cave entrance in a rock outcrop, and swerves toward it.
lighting: bright exterior light against the absolute black of the cave mouth
audio: percussion continues, wind, a hollow low tone from inside the cave
dialogue_fa: یه‌دفعه چشمم به یه غار افتاد. نمی‌دونستم داخلش چیه... ولی بیرون موندن قطعاً بدتر بود!
gloss_en: Suddenly I caught sight of a cave. I had no idea what was inside... but staying outside was definitely worse!
continuity: cave mouth sits above dry grass on the right side of a rock outcrop; reused in S13-S16
transition: whip pan follows him into the dark, motivating S13
image_prompt: Wide shot of a rocky outcrop above golden dry grass in prehistoric Africa, with a narrow dark cave mouth set in the rock face. KAIRO the stickman sprints toward it between boulders, hide tunic flapping, spear in hand. The cave interior is pure black, framed by sunlit stone. 2D cinematic animation, strong light-dark contrast, dust.
video_prompt: Panning follow shot of KAIRO running between boulders, then a fast whip pan that catches the black cave mouth in the rock face. He changes direction and drives toward it. Dust and grass seeds fly through frame. The darkness of the entrance holds against the bright exterior.
